town_layout — DRIVE town op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.town_layout(name: 'str' = 'default', *, overlap: 'float' = 0.05) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivetown; drivetown.town_layout(name: 'str' = 'default', *, overlap: 'float' = 0.05) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("town_layout"))

Usage

Default towns. "default" = road(30) → intersection → road(20) → crossing (railroad crossing) → road(20) → slope → road(20) → parallel_parking → road(30) (all 7 m wide; stop lines: 1 at the intersection and 1 at the railroad crossing). "short" = road(20) → crossing → road(20) (fast test gate).
